purpose: Check whether v21 titles clarify three historically ambiguous category relationships while remaining faithful to the exact masks.

pairs.reason: The user's explicit contains-ingredients versus is-an-ingredient concern.
Ingredient role versus foods/living animals and the poultry bird-versus-meat ambiguity.
Recipe/result versus preparation activity; poultry-product wording may clarify eggs versus meat.

generation: Fresh isolated call per group/trial, unchanged wrapper; only v21 prompt and deduplicated numbered exact masks. No note text, partner category, original title, historical judgments, TRUE scores or feedback.
evaluation: Record title-only interpretations in a clean-context review first, using anonymized and shuffled historical/new title pairs. Then check those interpretations against exact masks separately. Clear rejection can count as improved clarity; containment is not prescribed. Faithfulness and ambiguity are separate judgments; no unique target title or hierarchy.
limits: Small selected diagnostic, not general accuracy. Historical v20 titles are not newly rerun; generation nondeterminism limits causal attribution. No TRUE calls, inferred graph construction, upstream mask edits or new training.
preserve: Historical groups, vectors, prompts, results and user decisions remain untouched.
